answer: Proof of Agent deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing where nodes stake basalt assets to endorse graph edges. Evaluators execute topological cut verifications across clusters; if an adversary creates identity clusters over an artificial knoll in the trust network, conflicting attestations trigger immediate stake slashing. Honest nodes broadcast an alert signal across sparse cuts, imposing a superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^2)$.
